description: This Java enum defines different modes for sampling tracing spans in an OpenTracing system, including methods for retrieving the JSON representation and constructing enum instances from string values.

classes.name: TracingSamplingMode
classes.description: Java enum representing various sampling modes for tracing spans, with JSON serialization support and a method for creating enum instances from string values.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Returns the JSON string value associated with the sampling mode.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a TracingSamplingMode enum instance from a string value; defaults to DEFAULT if the value does not match any known mode.
